# ERDDAP Dataset Monitor

Monitor the availability and update status of selected datasets hosted on the CoastWatch West Coast Node ERDDAP server. Filter by satellite data product, status, or dataset name.

[Explore all ERDDAP dataset statuses](https://coastwatch.pfeg.noaa.gov/erddap/outOfDateDatasets.html){.cw-monitor-link target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"}

:::

```{python}
#| echo: false
#| output: asis
#| warning: false

import html
import pandas as pd
import yaml

from pathlib import Path
from urllib.parse import quote
from urllib.request import urlopen
from io import BytesIO
from IPython.display import display, HTML


# ==========================================================
# LOAD EDITABLE DATASET WATCHLIST
# ==========================================================

watchlist_path = Path("content/dataset_monitor.yml")

with open(watchlist_path, "r", encoding="utf-8") as file:
    watchlist = yaml.safe_load(file) or {}

watch = pd.DataFrame(watchlist.get("datasets", []))

for col in ("datasetID", "label", "category"):

    if col not in watch.columns:
        watch[col] = ""

    watch[col] = (
        watch[col]
        .fillna("")
        .astype(str)
        .str.strip()
    )

watch = (
    watch.loc[watch["datasetID"] != ""]
    .drop_duplicates(subset="datasetID", keep="first")
    .copy()
)

watch.loc[
    watch["label"] == "", "label"
] = watch["datasetID"]

watch.loc[
    watch["category"] == "", "category"
] = "Other"


# ==========================================================
# RETRIEVE ERDDAP STATUS DATA
# ==========================================================

status_url = (
    "https://coastwatch.pfeg.noaa.gov/erddap/"
    "outOfDateDatasets.csv"
)

fetch_error = None
status_available = False

try:

    with urlopen(status_url, timeout=30) as response:
        status = pd.read_csv(BytesIO(response.read()))

    status.columns = status.columns.str.strip()

    required_columns = {"datasetID", "outOfDate"}

    if not required_columns.issubset(status.columns):
        raise ValueError(
            "ERDDAP status table is missing required columns. "
            f"Available columns: {list(status.columns)}"
        )

    status["datasetID"] = (
        status["datasetID"]
        .fillna("")
        .astype(str)
        .str.strip()
    )

    status = status.drop_duplicates(
        subset="datasetID",
        keep="first"
    )

    df = watch.merge(
        status,
        on="datasetID",
        how="left"
    )

    status_available = True

except Exception as exc:

    fetch_error = str(exc)

    df = watch.copy()

    df["outOfDate"] = float("nan")
    df["maxTime"] = pd.NA


# ==========================================================
# CLASSIFY DATASET STATUS
# ==========================================================

scores = pd.to_numeric(
    df["outOfDate"],
    errors="coerce"
)


def classify_status(value):

    if not status_available:
        return "Unavailable"

    if pd.isna(value):
        return "Not Flagged"

    if value < 1:
        return "OK"

    if value < 2:
        return "Delayed"

    return "Outdated"


df["status"] = scores.apply(classify_status)

priority = {
    "Outdated": 0,
    "Delayed": 1,
    "OK": 2,
    "Not Flagged": 3,
    "Unavailable": 4
}

df["priority"] = df["status"].map(priority)

df = df.sort_values(
    ["priority", "category", "label"],
    kind="stable"
)


# ==========================================================
# HTML HELPERS
# ==========================================================

def esc(value):
    return html.escape(str(value), quote=True)


def safe_text(value, default="Not listed"):

    if pd.isna(value):
        return default

    value = str(value).strip()

    return esc(value) if value else default


counts = df["status"].value_counts()

html_parts = []


def add(content):
    html_parts.append(content)


# ==========================================================
# STATUS OVERVIEW
# ==========================================================

add("""
<div class="cw-monitor-summary">

  <div class="cw-monitor-summary-head">

    <div>
      <span class="cw-monitor-eyebrow">
        MONITORING OVERVIEW
      </span>

      <h2>Dataset update status</h2>
    </div>
""")

add(f"""
    <span class="cw-monitor-total">
      {len(df)} monitored datasets
    </span>

  </div>

  <div class="cw-monitor-stats">
""")


status_cards = [
    ("Outdated", "Outdated", "outdated"),
    ("Delayed", "Delayed", "delayed"),
    ("OK", "OK", "ok"),
    ("Not Flagged", "Not Flagged", "unflagged")
]

for key, label, css_class in status_cards:

    count = int(counts.get(key, 0))

    add(f"""
    <div class="cw-monitor-stat {css_class}">
      <strong>{count}</strong>
      <span>{label}</span>
    </div>
    """)

add("</div>")


# ==========================================================
# ERDDAP ERROR MESSAGE
# ==========================================================

if fetch_error:

    add(f"""
    <div class="cw-monitor-error" role="alert">
      <strong>ERDDAP status information unavailable.</strong>

      <p>
        The status table could not be retrieved during
        this website build. Dataset names and categories
        are still available, but their update statuses
        could not be verified.
      </p>

      <details>
        <summary>Technical details</summary>
        <code>{esc(fetch_error)}</code>
      </details>
    </div>
    """)


# ==========================================================
# FILTER CONTROLS
# ==========================================================

add("""
<div class="cw-monitor-controls">

  <div>
    <label for="monitorSearch">
      Search datasets
    </label>

    <input
      id="monitorSearch"
      type="search"
      placeholder="Search dataset name or ID..."
    >
  </div>

  <div>
    <label for="categoryFilter">
      Satellite data product
    </label>

    <select id="categoryFilter">
      <option value="all">All products</option>
    </select>
  </div>

  <div>
    <label for="statusFilter">
      Status
    </label>

    <select id="statusFilter">
      <option value="all">All statuses</option>
    </select>
  </div>

  <button
    id="monitorReset"
    type="button"
  >
    Reset filters
  </button>

</div>

<div class="cw-monitor-legend">

  <span>
    <b>Out-of-date score:</b>
    &lt;1 OK · 1–&lt;2 Delayed · ≥2 Outdated
  </span>

  <span>
    Not Flagged = no score in the ERDDAP status table
  </span>

</div>

</div>
""")


# ==========================================================
# RESULTS SECTION
# ==========================================================

add("""
<div class="cw-monitor-results">

  <div class="cw-monitor-results-head">

    <h2>Monitored datasets</h2>

    <span
      id="monitorCount"
      aria-live="polite"
    ></span>

  </div>

  <div
    id="monitorGrid"
    class="cw-monitor-grid"
  >
""")


# ==========================================================
# GENERATE DATASET CARDS
# ==========================================================

for _, row in df.iterrows():

    dataset_id = str(row["datasetID"])

    dataset_url = (
        "https://coastwatch.pfeg.noaa.gov/erddap/info/"
        + quote(dataset_id, safe="")
        + "/index.html"
    )

    label = esc(row["label"])
    category = esc(row["category"])

    status_text = str(row["status"])

    status_class = (
        status_text
        .lower()
        .replace(" ", "-")
    )

    score = pd.to_numeric(
        pd.Series([row["outOfDate"]]),
        errors="coerce"
    ).iloc[0]

    score_text = (
        f"{score:.2f}"
        if pd.notna(score)
        else "Not listed"
    )

    latest_text = safe_text(
        row.get("maxTime")
    )

    search_text = esc(
        (
            str(row["label"])
            + " "
            + dataset_id
            + " "
            + str(row["category"])
        ).lower()
    )

    add(f"""
    <article
      class="cw-monitor-item {status_class}"
      data-category="{category}"
      data-status="{esc(status_text)}"
      data-search="{search_text}"
    >

      <div class="cw-monitor-item-body">

        <h3>
          <a
            href="{esc(dataset_url)}"
            target="_blank"
            rel="noopener noreferrer"
          >
            {label}
          </a>
        </h3>

        <p class="cw-monitor-id">
          Dataset ID:
          <code>{esc(dataset_id)}</code>
        </p>

        <div class="cw-monitor-meta">

          <span>
            <b>Out-of-date score:</b>
            {score_text}
          </span>

          <span>
            <b>Latest available data:</b>
            {latest_text}
          </span>

        </div>

      </div>

      <div class="cw-monitor-tags">

        <span class="cw-monitor-category">
          {category}
        </span>

        <span class="cw-monitor-badge">
          {esc(status_text)}
        </span>

      </div>

    </article>
    """)


# ==========================================================
# CLOSE RESULTS SECTION
# ==========================================================

add("""
  </div>

  <p
    id="monitorEmpty"
    class="cw-monitor-empty"
    hidden
  >
    No datasets match the current filters.
  </p>

</div>
""")


# ==========================================================
# DISPLAY HTML
# ==========================================================

display(HTML("\n".join(html_parts)))
```


<!-- ======================================================
     INTERACTIVE FILTERING
     ====================================================== -->

```{=html}
<script>
(function () {

  function init() {

    const grid = document.getElementById("monitorGrid");

    if (!grid) return;

    const rows = [
      ...grid.querySelectorAll(".cw-monitor-item")
    ];

    const category = document.getElementById("categoryFilter");
    const status = document.getElementById("statusFilter");
    const search = document.getElementById("monitorSearch");
    const count = document.getElementById("monitorCount");
    const empty = document.getElementById("monitorEmpty");
    const reset = document.getElementById("monitorReset");


    // =====================================================
    // POPULATE CATEGORY FILTER
    // =====================================================

    const categories = [
      ...new Set(
        rows.map(row => row.dataset.category)
      )
    ].sort();

    categories.forEach(value => {
      category.add(new Option(value, value));
    });


    // =====================================================
    // POPULATE STATUS FILTER
    // =====================================================

    const statuses = [
      "Outdated",
      "Delayed",
      "OK",
      "Not Flagged",
      "Unavailable"
    ];

    statuses.forEach(value => {

      if (
        rows.some(
          row => row.dataset.status === value
        )
      ) {
        status.add(new Option(value, value));
      }

    });


    // =====================================================
    // FILTER DATASETS
    // =====================================================

    function update() {

      const term = search.value.trim().toLowerCase();

      let visible = 0;

      rows.forEach(row => {

        const categoryMatch =
          category.value === "all" ||
          row.dataset.category === category.value;

        const statusMatch =
          status.value === "all" ||
          row.dataset.status === status.value;

        const searchMatch =
          !term ||
          row.dataset.search.includes(term);

        const show =
          categoryMatch &&
          statusMatch &&
          searchMatch;

        row.hidden = !show;

        if (show) {
          visible++;
        }

      });

      count.textContent =
        `${visible} of ${rows.length} datasets shown`;

      empty.hidden = visible !== 0;

    }


    // =====================================================
    // EVENT LISTENERS
    // =====================================================

    category.addEventListener("change", update);

    status.addEventListener("change", update);

    search.addEventListener("input", update);


    // =====================================================
    // RESET FILTERS
    // =====================================================

    reset.addEventListener("click", () => {

      category.value = "all";
      status.value = "all";
      search.value = "";

      update();

    });


    // =====================================================
    // INITIALIZE
    // =====================================================

    update();

  }


  if (document.readyState === "loading") {

    document.addEventListener(
      "DOMContentLoaded",
      init
    );

  } else {

    init();

  }

})();
</script>
```
